transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I’ve just been feeling really sad when I wake up—heavy and kind of hollow. It’s like I’m there, the day is starting, but there’s no music in me anymore. That’s what made me come in.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About nine months, I think. It’s been there most of that time—the depressed feeling, especially in the mornings.
Do you still enjoy activities that you used to find pleasurable?
I’m not really sure. Some things still feel okay once I’m doing them, but I haven’t been paying close attention to whether I enjoy them the same way I used to.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in things you used to like?
I’m not sure. I mean, I don’t reach for things the way I used to, but I haven’t really paid attention to whether that’s loss of interest or just feeling low.
Do you feel like you've been able to experience pleasure when you're doing things you used to enjoy?
I don’t really know. I haven’t been paying close enough attention to say yes or no. Sometimes if I’m doing something, it’s not bad, but I can’t tell if it feels like pleasure the way it used to.
Can you think of anything recently that you've done and actually felt happy about?
I’m having a hard time thinking of something specific. Maybe small moments felt okay, but I don’t know if I’d call it happy exactly.
Do you feel like you've lost pleasure in activities that normally would bring you happiness?
I’m not really sure. I’ve noticed I don’t get the same pull toward things, but I can’t clearly say the pleasure is gone. It’s more like... things feel kind of muted, maybe.
Have you been feeling more tired than usual?
Yeah. I’ve been getting wiped out by really small things, like answering one email to a dancer or even just showering with this ankle brace on. And lying down doesn’t really seem to recharge me much.
Have you noticed any significant change in your weight recently?

Yeah, a bit. I haven’t been weighing myself much, but my rehearsal clothes feel looser lately. When I was really buzzing with ideas I’d just skip meals without realizing, and now food doesn’t taste like much… kind of like cardboard.
Have you been feeling restless or sluggish lately?
Sluggish, more than restless. Lately even just crossing the studio to pick up my notebook feels slow, like my body is moving through wet sand instead of moving with the music.
Have you been feeling guilty about anything lately?

Yeah. I keep going over the cancelled performances in my head and thinking I let everyone down—the dancers, the funders, people in the community. Everyone’s been pretty kind about it, honestly, but I keep feeling like I don’t really deserve that.
Have you been having any thoughts about hurting yourself?
I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve felt really low and ashamed, but I haven’t been thinking about hurting myself.
Have you had any days in the past two weeks where you felt somewhat better, not as depressed?
Not really. Most mornings I wake up with this heavy, empty sadness. It feels like the lights are on in the studio, but there’s no music in me. I haven’t had much of a break from that.
Have you had any significant difficulty concentrating or making decisions lately?

Yes, definitely. I’ll sit down to do something simple, like finish a grant report, and then some little thing pulls me off track—a truck going by outside, a photo on the wall, even one phrase in old rehearsal notes. Suddenly I’m thinking about a completely different plan, and I haven’t made any progress on what I meant to do.
Do you feel like you're moving more slowly than you used to, or is it more that you just don't feel like doing things?
It’s more that I feel slowed down. Like even crossing the studio to pick up my notebook takes effort. My body feels like it’s moving through wet sand instead of just... moving normally.
Have you had any periods in the last two weeks where you felt nearly normal, without any depression?
No, I don’t think so. It’s been pretty constant—waking up with that heavy, hollow sadness. Even when I’m in the studio, it feels like the lights are on but there’s no music in me.
Have you had any thoughts that you're a burden to others?

Yes. I keep thinking I’ve become a burden, or at least that I’ve let everyone down. I replay the cancelled performances over and over and tell myself I failed the dancers, the funders, the community… even though people have been kinder to me than I feel like I deserve.
Do you feel like you're resting or moving more quickly than you used to, or is it just that you don't feel like doing things?
It’s more that I’m moving slower, not quicker. Like I said, even just walking across the studio to get my notebook feels like a lot. My body feels heavy, like I’m moving through wet sand.
Have you had any thoughts about death or wishing you were dead?
No… I don’t think so. I’ve felt really low and guilty, but I haven’t been wishing I was dead.
Have you had any days in the past month where you felt completely normal, without any symptoms of depression?

Not really, no. Most mornings I wake up with this heavy, hollow sadness. It’s like everything is technically there, but there’s no music in me. I don’t think I’ve had a day this month where I felt completely normal.
